## The project

**NCLEX-PN remediation coach.** A Python CLI that reads `seed/missed.json` (your NCLEX-PN / Canadian RPN missed-question tags: topic, client need, why you missed it) and prints a 7-day remediation plan. Stays local, plain JSON files, no database.

## Rules that apply

**Hard constraints:**
- Python standard library only, no network, no external dependencies
- Only topic tags and your own notes — zero paid qbank text (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan), even paraphrased
- **Every remediation drill must be PN scope only:** reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan. No RN wording (independently assess, initiate treatment, create protocols)
- This stays personal — don't package it, GitHub it, or distribute it

**Decisions:**
- Plain JSON files so you can edit on your phone in a text editor
- No gamification (no streaks, badges, leaderboards) — keep it focused
